the rs1124943 breast cancer susceptibility SNP is associated with risk of ER-positive breast cancer, especially when the tumor is of the lobular histology and has low expression of the E-cadherins gene.

we identified the rs1124943 SNP to be associated with breast cancer risk and that the risk was stronger for tumors with low expression of the E-cadherine protein, which plays a role in the adhesion of cells to each other and in the formation of epithelial tissues.
